clean_story:
Now I will teach you Thoughts. Thoughts are like shadows in your head, but not from fire or sun. They move when you remember mammoth or think of spear. They come before you do, like wind before storm. You see them not, but they are there, like smell of wet earth after rain. They make you stop, go, or hit rock with stick. This is Thoughts.

Discover now: dreams, memories, sky.
